There is the one infinite, eternal enlightened being, which has poured out over itself into finite, temporal forms of manifestation, which stream back for infinity. There are some forms which are not primed to know this original infinite nature, though they be it. There are some forms primed yet not ready to know, yet they be it. There are some primed, who have known, or have the knowledge in them, but have forgotten or obscured it, yet they are it. There are those who know, that is to say, they be it yet.
